name: PayMongo
description: PayMongo is a Philippine online payments company. It provides payment links, checkout integrations, and e-wallet acceptance for Filipino businesses.

name: NextPay
tagline: Digital banking for Philippine small businesses.
description: NextPay is a Philippine digital banking platform for small businesses, offering invoicing, payments, and cash management tools.

name: Alien Inc
tagline: Seven independent companies, one operating system.
description: Alien Inc is a Philippine technology group and the independent guardian of Philippine digital infrastructure — detecting sabotage, tracking data center development, and verifying that facilities are safe and recoverable.

name: Kumu
tagline: Livestreaming and social entertainment for Filipinos.
description: Kumu is a Philippine livestreaming and social entertainment platform where Filipino creators broadcast live shows and connect with their communities.

name: Kalibrr
tagline: Jobs and hiring for the Philippines.
description: Kalibrr is a Philippine jobs and hiring platform connecting Filipino job seekers with employers across the country and beyond.
